name: Mini Golf³
summary:
Mini Golf³ is a brand-new way to be challenged on the mini golf course. Grab your best virtual putter, put on some checkered trousers and let's go tee off in this arcade-styled mini golf game.

With multiple unique cubes designed to both assist and block your progress, you are encouraged to take risks and be creative to get to the hole in as few shots as possible. 

Using comfortable physics, retro sound effects and unique putters and golf balls, can you think outside the cube?
